title: The Two Become River

features.name: merged current becoming
features.desc-on-touch: You witness two streams that ran in parallel find each other. The turbulence where they meet is not chaos—it is a becoming. The two are no longer counting themselves as separate.

features.name: dusk-split reflection
features.desc-on-touch: You see the water reflects both the magenta and the terracotta sky at once, holding both colours without choosing. In merging, nothing is lost.

features.name: banks that learned each other
features.desc-on-touch: You observe how the banks have learned each other—stone on one side, soil on the other. Where they meet, new stone grows. The banks are merging into one continuous hold.

features.name: signal becoming speech
features.desc-on-touch: You hear two frequencies that once broadcast separate messages now harmonized. The interference pattern has become a song neither could sing alone.

features.name: braided navigation
features.desc-on-touch: You trace the river's path—no longer straight, but braided where the two currents wove themselves together. To navigate is to follow the logic of merging, not of going straight.

inscription: the merger is not loss; it is the moment two separate songs become one voice singing in harmony

file.name: Current_Harmonics_Dual_Source_Log_Merged.mp3
file.note: recording of two broadcast signals mixing in real time; the resulting tone is neither frequency, but the difference between them—a ghost signal born from convergence
